lines.say: What if Israel acted like Iran's regime?
Iran's regime has been on the US terror sponsor list since 1984.
Let's do the math, per person.
In 2025, Iran executed at least 1,639 people.
At Israel's size, that's about one hundred eighty a year.
Israel's real number? Two, since 1948. One was Nazi Holocaust organizer Adolf Eichmann.
In January 2026, Iran's own government admitted 3,117 protest deaths.
At Israel's size: over three hundred.
In 2023, hundreds of thousands of Israelis protested for months. Nobody was shot.
The opposition sits in the Knesset.
Land? Israel gave back Sinai, almost three times its size.
It left Lebanon in 2000, and Gaza in 2005, moving out over eight thousand of its own citizens.
Israel makes mistakes, and its wars cost real lives.
But regimes like Iran's don't give land back, and can't be voted out.
Restraint: strength or weakness? Tell me below.
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
Now picture Israel at Iran's rate.

caption_en:
One number changes how this debate sounds.

If Israel acted like Iran's regime, here is the math, per person:

Iran executed at least 1,639 people in 2025, the most since 1989 (Iran Human Rights and ECPM, April 2026). Iran has about 92 million people (UN, 2025). At that rate, Israel's 10.2 million (CBS) would mean about 180 executions a year. Israel's real total since 1948: two, one of them Nazi Holocaust organizer Adolf Eichmann (1962).

In January 2026, Iran's own government admitted 3,117 deaths in its protest crackdown (AFP); rights groups say far more. At Israel's size: more than 300.

In 2023, hundreds of thousands of Israelis protested their government for months, and nobody was shot. The opposition sits in the Knesset.

Land: Israel returned Sinai in 1982 (about 60,000 km², almost 3x Israel's 22,072 km²), left south Lebanon in 2000 (confirmed by the UN) and left Gaza in 2005, moving out over 8,000 of its own citizens.

Iran's regime has been on the US State Sponsors of Terrorism list since 1984.

Israel makes mistakes, and its wars cost real lives. But regimes like Iran's don't give land back, and can't be voted out.

Is restraint strength or weakness? Tell me in the comments.

caption_he:
מה אם ישראל הייתה מתנהגת כמו המשטר באיראן? איראן הוציאה להורג לפחות 1,639 בני אדם ב־2025. בקנה המידה של ישראל: כ־180 בשנה. ישראל: שתי הוצאות להורג מאז 1948, אחת מהן אייכמן.
בינואר 2026 הממשלה באיראן עצמה הודתה ב־3,117 הרוגים בדיכוי המחאה. ב־2023 מאות אלפי ישראלים הפגינו חודשים, ואף אחד לא נורה.
ישראל החזירה את סיני (1982), יצאה מלבנון (2000) ומעזה (2005).
ישראל טועה, ולמלחמות שלה יש מחיר אמיתי בחיים. אבל משטרים כאלה לא מחזירים שטח ואי אפשר להחליף אותם בבחירות.
